project: Wuxia Life P73 Renown On-Ramp Spine
description: Build the minimum playable on-ramp spine event for the jianghu_renown_sage route so it has real content beyond entry labels, while staying bounded and preserving the tavern-born flavor.

userStories.title: Audit renown on-ramp gap
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of what currently exists for jianghu_renown_sage after entry so P73 targets the real on-ramp gap.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize existing renown route flags, markers, expression, and events
Identify what exists before on-ramp vs what the minimum spine needs
Save docs/test-reports/p73-renown-on-ramp-gap-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Gap audit complete: existing bridge + 6+ expression surfaces identified; 3 core gaps (on-ramp event, checkpoint flag, expression updates) documented.

userStories.title: Lock P73 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P73 stays an on-ramp spine stage and does not sprawl into full renown content.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P73 to on-ramp spine event plus corresponding expression only
Define allowed layers: event configuration, expression, proof, and narrow tests
List forbidden expansions: pressure wave, payoff wave, new systems, full route expansion, second route
Save docs/test-reports/p73-renown-on-ramp-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope contract locked: 4 allowed layers (event config, expression, proof, narrow tests), 6 forbidden expansions (pressure, payoff, new systems, full expansion, second route, other origins).

userStories.title: Define renown on-ramp contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit on-ramp contract for jianghu_renown_sage so the first post-bridge milestone feels like a renown-specific turning point.
acceptanceCriteria: Define on-ramp trigger conditions (post-bridge + age range + minimum renown/network threshold)
Define the core narrative: what is the first iconic milestone of a jianghu renown sage
Preserve tavern-born flavor (network path from tavern origins)
Reserve flag interfaces for subsequent pressure/payoff stages
Record the contract in the PRD or an appendix
userStories.notes: On-ramp contract defined: '江湖调解' event at age 32-35, post-bridge trigger, tavern-born flavor preserved, 2 choices (accept/decline), renown_on_ramp_done checkpoint, flag interfaces for pressure/payoff stages reserved. Saved to docs/PRD/p73-renown-on-ramp-contract.md.

userStories.title: Wire renown on-ramp spine event
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the renown on-ramp event wired through the existing event system so players crossing the renown bridge encounter a real milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement on-ramp spine event through existing event system configuration
Do not introduce a new event framework or scheduler
Trigger conditions are compatible with P71 bridge and P72 entry
P71/P72 existing evidence does not regress
Shared destination chain remains stably triggerable
userStories.notes: Renown on-ramp event wired in sample-lines-spine.json — auto event 'renown_on_ramp' at age 32-35, triggers on tavern_renown_bridge_crossed, sets renown_on_ramp_done + tavern_renown_on_ramp, stat boosts (reputation +5, connections +4, charisma +2). No new framework. P71/P72 tests pass, sample-lines guard pass.

userStories.title: Add on-ramp player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the renown on-ramp to read as a meaningful turning point so the route feels like it has content beyond entry labels.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least two on-ramp-specific readable signals (currentGoal update, identity summary, etc.)
After on-ramp, players can feel 'I have truly gained fame in the jianghu'
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests

userStories.title: Add targeted on-ramp proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the renown on-ramp event fires correctly and carries tavern-born renown flavor.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one targeted proof (bridge to on-ramp path verification)
Show on-ramp event trigger plus expression changes
Do not require full lifetime exhaust
Proof supports whether to continue to pressure stage

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the renown on-ramp spine so future edits do not break the first renown content milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover at least on-ramp trigger conditions, event firing, expression updates, and comparison assertions
Reuse existing test harness
Do not rewrite the full test suite
Relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce P73 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what the renown on-ramp provides and whether pressure/payoff stages are justified next.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p73-renown-on-ramp-closure-report.md
Summarize gap audit, contract, event wiring, expression, proof, and tests
State whether the subsequent pressure stage is worth opening
List larger renown-expansion items that remain deferred
